name: Folder sorter
description: Files dropped into the Sort Me folder are moved into a subfolder for their type (PDFs, Images, Documents, Archives, Other). Create the folder before activating.

parameters.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

def main(input):
    src = Path(input['path'])
    if not src.exists():
        log(f'{src} no longer exists, nothing to do')
        return {'moved': False, 'reason': 'missing', 'name': input['name']}
    ext = src.suffix.lower()
    group = next((g for g, exts in args['groups'].items() if ext in exts), 'Other')
    target_dir = src.parent / group
    target_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    target = target_dir / src.name
    n = 1
    while target.exists():
        target = target_dir / f'{src.stem} ({n}){src.suffix}'
        n += 1
    shutil.move(str(src), str(target))
    log(f'Moved {src.name} -> {group}')
    return {'moved': True, 'group': group, 'to': str(target), 'name': src.name}
